question: Card C with up to 2 tags beside status and priority, and the footer tags gone. Only the tag look differs. A: outline badges. B: quiet #tag text. C: filled badges. Which fits? ("+n" shows past 2 tags. No sample task has more than 2.)

variants.label: Outline tags
variants.changes: Up to 2 tags join the status and priority row, with "+n" for the rest. Footer tags removed. Tags are outline badges, the same as the status badge.

variants.label: Quiet #tags
variants.changes: Up to 2 tags join the status and priority row, with "+n" for the rest. Footer tags removed. Tags are muted "#tag" text with no badge.

variants.label: Filled tags
variants.changes: Up to 2 tags join the status and priority row, with "+n" for the rest. Footer tags removed. Tags are secondary (filled) badges with no border.
